  </div>

  <p style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;color:#344054;margin:0 0 12px 0;padding:0;max-width:1120px;">Our final GBM model identified five key drivers — with one surprising finding about AI attitudes in 2025.</p>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr 1fr;gap:18px;flex:1;align-items:stretch;">

    <div style="padding:14px 22px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">

      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:16px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;">
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">1.</div>

          <div style="text-align:right;font-weight:720;color:#315f9f;">100</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;">
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">2.</div>
          <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Salary</strong> (log-transformed yearly compensation)</div>

        </div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;">
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">3.</div>
          <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Employment status</strong> & <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">YearsCode</strong></div>
          <div style="text-align:right;font-weight:720;color:#315f9f;">~15</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;">
          <div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">4.</div>
          <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Career doubt</strong> — "considered changing my career"</div>
          <div style="text-align:right;font-weight:720;color:#315f9f;">~9</div>
        </div>

        <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr 60px;gap:10px;align-items:center;">

          <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AI attitudes</strong> — AIThreat, AISent, AIAcc <em>(multiple variables)</em></div>
          <div style="text-align:right;font-weight:720;color:#315f9f;">~8</div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="padding:14px 22px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">

      <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Predicts:</strong> Unsatisfied / Neutral / Satisfied</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Strategy:</strong> Gradient boosting + square-root class weights</div>
        <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Tuned via:</strong> Stratified 3-fold CV, Macro F1 metric</div>
      </div>

      <div style="margin-top:10px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;">
        <div style="padding:10px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;">

          <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">0.4707</div>
        </div>
        <div style="padding:10px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:10px;text-align:center;">
          <div style="font-size:13px;color:#315f9f;font-weight:720;">Kappa</div>
          <div style="font-size:22px;font-weight:760;color:#1f2a44;">0.2414</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px 12px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:10px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.32;color:#344054;">
        <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Note on LeavingScore:</strong> Its dominance reflects the natural overlap between leaving intent and dissatisfaction — a methodological caveat we openly acknowledge.

</div>

  </div>

  <p style="font-size:20px;line-height:1.3;color:#344054;margin:0 0 14px 0;padding:0;max-width:1120px;">Five AI-related variables entered the Top 15 predictors — a finding unique to the post-ChatGPT developer landscape.</p>

  <div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;flex:1;align-items:stretch;">

    <div style="padding:14px 22px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;display:flex;flex-direction:column;">

          <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AIThreat: "Yes"</strong> — feels threatened by AI
          <div style="color:#c0392b;font-size:14px;margin-top:2px;">→ associated with lower satisfaction</div>
        </div>

        <div style="padding:8px 12px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:10px;">
          <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AISent: "Very unfavorable"</strong> — dislikes AI tools
          <div style="color:#c0392b;font-size:14px;margin-top:2px;">→ associated with lower satisfaction</div>
        </div>

        <div style="padding:8px 12px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:10px;">
          <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AIAcc: "Highly distrust"</strong> — distrusts AI accuracy
          <div style="color:#c0392b;font-size:14px;margin-top:2px;">→ associated with lower satisfaction</div>
        </div>

        <div style="padding:8px 12px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:10px;">
          <strong style="color:#1f2a44;">AISent: "Very favorable"</strong> — embraces AI
          <div style="color:#27ae60;font-size:14px;margin-top:2px;">→ associated with higher satisfaction</div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;">

      <div style="padding:14px 22px;background:#ffffff;border:1px solid #d7dee8;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;">
        <div style="font-size:19px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Why Does This Matter?</div>
        <div style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;color:#344054;">
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Fear of replacement</strong> → daily workplace anxiety</div>
          <div style="margin-bottom:6px;"><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Distrust of AI tools</strong> → friction adopting new workflows</div>
          <div><strong style="color:#1f2a44;">Optimism toward AI</strong> → sense of growth and adaptability</div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="padding:14px 22px;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;border-radius:14px;box-sizing:border-box;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;">
        <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:760;color:#315f9f;margin-bottom:8px;">Key Insight</div>
        <div style="font-size:18px;line-height:1.4;color:#1f2a44;font-weight:600;">
          In 2025, a developer's attitude toward AI is as predictive of job satisfaction as their salary or experience.
        </div>
        <div style="margin-top:8px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.35;color:#344054;font-style:italic;">
          The AI revolution isn't just changing what developers code — it's changing how they feel about coding.
        </div>
      </div>

  <div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:19px;line-height:1.25;color:#1f2a44;background:#f8fbff;border:1px solid #d6e4fb;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;text-align:center;font-weight:720;box-sizing:border-box;">Developers who embrace AI tend to be satisfied. Those who fear or distrust them tend to be unhappy. Mindset matters.</div>
